question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Extingish"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**Extinguish**" which means to put out a fire or light; to bring to an end. (बुझाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The firefighters worked hard to **extinguish **the blazing inferno.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dependent** (निर्भर): Relying on someone or something else for support or existence.

 
 
• **Example:** She is still **dependent **on her parents for financial support.
 
 
 
• **Announcement** (घोषणा): A formal public statement about a fact, occurrence, or intention.
 
 
• **Example:** The government made an **announcement **about the new policy changes today.
 
 
 
• **Extravagant** (फिजूलखर्ची): Lacking restraint in spending money or using resources.
 
 
• **Example:** His **extravagant **lifestyle led to his eventual bankruptcy.
